qualification: Exact source traces only for BERT/Burn. Portable core executes separately; no BERT model, tokenizer artifact, native GPU or full ESP inference build.

traces.title: Tokenizer retains the mask with batch-longest padding
Provider sends IDs without the mask
Self attention softmax has no padding mask input
Mean pooling uses every sequence position
Batched cosine has independent normalization and ranking
BERT feed-forward unconditionally uses GELU
